recentItems.title: Reactions To The Preseason Finale + Roster Predictions
recentItems.description:
Matt Williamson & Wes Uhler react to the Steelers’ preseason finale against the Buffalo Bills and share their biggest takeaways from the game. Plus, the guys make their predictions for the Steelers’ 53-man roster ahead of cut day this Sunday at 6 PM on SNR Drive, Friday, August 28th, 2026

The opinions expressed in this video are their own and not those of the Pittsburgh Steelers.
